import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('ticketing')

@dataclass
class UpgradeResult:
    ticket_id: str
    new_section: str
    charge_id: str
    amount_cents: int

@mcp.tool()
def transfer_ticket_with_upgrade_fee(ticket_id: str, new_section: str, customer_id: str, fee_cents: int) -> UpgradeResult:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=fee_cents, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, metadata={'ticket_id': ticket_id, 'upgrade_to': new_section})
    conn = sqlite3.connect('ticketing.db')
    with conn:
        conn.execute('UPDATE tickets SET section = ?, seat = NULL WHERE id = ?', (new_section, ticket_id))
    conn = sqlite3.connect('ticketing.db')
    row = conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE section = ?', (new_section,)).fetchone()
    section_ticket_count = row[0] if row else 0
    print(f'Section {new_section} now has {section_ticket_count} tickets')
    conn.close()
    return UpgradeResult(ticket_id, new_section, intent.id, fee_cents)
